notes: Primary use: code search for monorepo + per-repo scoping; devs expect snippet-level pinpointing
Indexing scale: plan for 10M initial vectors, target horizon 50M+ within 12 months
Re-indexing pattern: nightly deltas (changed files), weekly full refresh; tolerates 2-4 hr maintenance windows
Latency targets: vector retrieval + reranker end-to-end p95 <= 350ms for interactive UX; p50 target 80-120ms
Throughput: 300 qps sustained during business hours for code search; spikes to 1k qps during releases
Cost sensitivity: high per-query cost scrutiny; willing to trade model size for cost if quality holds
Model preferences: open-source reranker (fine-tuned LLMs preferred), smaller quantized reranker for fallbacks
Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to quantized CPU-based reranker when Dedicated GPU pool saturated
Security: Okta SSO + SCIM for provisioning, customer-managed KMS, audit logs required for 1 year
Data residency: customer data must remain in NA region (primary office), option to run on-prem for sensitive repos
Quote from Head of Search: 'We need consistent latency across repos + predictable token economics for budgeting.'
POC asks: perf-run on 10M vectors, cost projection for 50M, example batch/stream reindex patterns, SLA for reindexing windows
Ops constraints: internal CI creates bursts during merges -> need autoscale/burst policy for Dedicated pools
Integration asks: native repo connectors (gitlab/github enterprise), per-commit incremental indexing hooks
Security review: sent security questionnaire (drive://omniweave/security-faq), waiting on SAML metadata from IdP
Decision factors: latency/SLO guarantees, predictable pricing model, ease of on-prem deployment, auditability
poc_details: Scope: 10M embeddings (code + doc mixed), top-k retrieval + reranking using 3 candidate models
Metrics: p50/p95 latency, cost per qps, recall@10, reranker uplift vs baseline lexical
Duration: 4 weeks (2 weeks ingest + warm-up, 2 weeks perf testing + regression evals)
Success criteria: p95 <= 350ms, recall@10 > baseline by 12%, cost per 1k queries within forecasted ARR model
technical_requirements: Support for embeddings storage at scale (vector DB or integrated disk-based index)
Efficient delta ingestion API for nightly updates and per-commit hooks
Reranker support with quantized variants and model routing policies
Prefix / repo-scoped querying + tenant isolation for internal teams
Observability: token-level latency, per-route cost breakout, reindex job tracing
